newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann says closes DBKom deal.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann says closes DBKom deal.

text.p: Mannesmann AG said on Thursday it had closed a deal with German railway Deutsche Bahn AG for a Mannesmann-led group to buy 49.8 percent of telecommunications unit DBKom for about one billion marks.
Mannesmann's CNI unit will be merged with DBKom, it said.
The merger is subject to the approval of the European Commission and the Mannesmann supervisory board. Deutsche Bahn's supervisory board has already voted to approve it.
Mannesmann holds 70 percent of the consortium, which also includes AT&T and European telecoms venture Unisource NV, each with 15 percent.
The merger will create Germany's second-largest phones carrier after Deutsche Telekom, with annual sales of over one billion marks ($663.2 million).
Mannesmann's consortium has an option to increase its stake in the new group to 74.9 percent within three years.
-- Terence Gallagher, Bonn newsroom, 49 228 26097150 ($ = 1.507 German Marks)
